Contributing to the application

Contributions are welcome: bug reports, fixes and game compatibility notes.

Reporting a bug

Open an issue and select the appropriate template. In the application, Help › Run Diagnostics… writes a report covering settings and recent logs; attaching it usually avoids an exchange of questions. Remove anything you do not want to share before attaching it.

Building

An Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later with Xcode 16 or later is required. Dependencies are resolved by the Swift Package Manager.

Vodka is part of the Vodka Stack monorepo. The application project resides in apps/vodka:

git clone https://github.com/rolling7ho/vodka-stack.git
cd Vodka/apps/vodka
open Vodka.xcodeproj           # or build from the command line:
scripts/install-local.sh       # Release build, ad-hoc signed, installed to /Applications

The project comprises four parts:

Part Responsibility
Vodka/ The SwiftUI application
VodkaKit/ Swift package containing the logic: Wine, PCs, Steam, the library and playtime
VodkaCmd/ Command-line tool used by Dock shortcuts to start games
VodkaThumbnail/ Quick Look thumbnail extension for .exe files

Before you open a pull request

swift test --package-path VodkaKit   # unit tests
swiftformat --lint .                 # formatting (CI pins SwiftFormat 0.58.7)

SwiftLint runs as part of the Xcode build and any violation fails the build. It is skipped when CI=true is set, so run swiftlint --strict explicitly before opening a pull request. Every Swift file begins with the license header reading "This file is part of Vodka, a fork of Whisky."; copy it from an existing file.

Guidelines

  • Every change lands through a pull request. Direct pushes to main are not accepted.
  • Keep pull requests small. One fix or feature per pull request.
  • Strings. Add new user-facing text to Vodka/Localizable.xcstrings in English only. Edit the file as text and modify only the required lines. Re-saving it with a JSON tool reorders the entire catalog and makes the diff unreviewable.
  • Xcode project. VodkaKit discovers new files automatically. Files added to the application target also require entries in Vodka.xcodeproj.
  • Changelog. Describe user-facing changes under [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md.
  • Game fixes. A fix that only changes settings belongs in VodkaKit/Sources/VodkaKit/GameDatabase/Resources/GameDB.json, with a link to the origin of the fix.
  • Secrets. CI scans every push with TruffleHog. Run the same check locally with scripts/scan-secrets.sh.

Releasing an update

Installed copies check https://rolling7ho.github.io/vodka-stack/appcast.xml, served from the gh-pages branch, through Sparkle. To publish an update, describe it under [Unreleased] in the changelog, commit the working tree, and run:

scripts/publish-update.sh 4.0.1

The script moves the changelog entries into the new version, increments the marketing and build versions, builds and ad-hoc signs the application, signs the archive with the Sparkle key, creates the app-v4.0.1 GitHub release, and adds the release to the appcast on gh-pages. Signing requires the Sparkle key in the maintainer's login keychain (account vodka) or at ~/.vodka-sparkle-private-key. Retain a backup of the key: installed copies accept updates only when signed with that key.
